claim: Commit 950c963644 (PR #2434, merged 2026-08-25T18:27:45Z) changed the EndpointPickerConfig discovery key from dataLayer.discovery.pluginRef to dataLayer.discovery.endpoints.pluginRef, and moved peer discovery from dataLayer.peerDiscovery.pluginRef to dataLayer.discovery.peers.pluginRef.
stance_target: exact EndpointPickerConfig discovery key shape before vs. after the Aug 25 2026 consolidation
quoted_support:
Group endpoint discovery and peer discovery under dataLayer.discovery
with endpoints and peers sub-fields instead of two separate top-level
fields (dataLayer.discovery and dataLayer.peerDiscovery).

claim: A migration shim (migrateDiscoveryConfig in pkg/epp/config/loader/configloader.go) preserves backward compatibility: if the deprecated dataLayer.discovery.pluginRef is set and dataLayer.discovery.endpoints.pluginRef is not, the loader copies the value into Endpoints.PluginRef and logs a deprecation warning; if both are set, the new field wins.
stance_target: whether pre-consolidation configs still work after the Aug 25 2026 change
quoted_support: logger.Info("DEPRECATION: dataLayer.discovery.pluginRef is deprecated, use dataLayer.discovery.endpoints.pluginRef instead. If both are set, the new field is used.")

claim: The pre-release dataLayer.peerDiscovery field (introduced in PR #2341) was deleted outright with no migration shim because it had never shipped in a release, unlike the endpoint-discovery pluginRef migration which was preserved because it had shipped.
stance_target: llm-d-router's deprecation/compatibility policy for unreleased vs. released config fields
quoted_support:
The dataLayer.peerDiscovery field was introduced in #2341 but never
shipped in a release, so no users depend on it. Remove the field, its
migration shim, and its test instead of carrying unnecessary deprecation
machinery. The endpoint discovery pluginRef migration (which IS released)
is preserved.
